title: Create a Space previews carry each theme's small design details

source.ref: Owner 2026-11-14: finish the remaining preview details (Wildheart stag logo, per-theme nav links, Temple next-gathering card, Bold stand-in photos).

detail: Follow-up to LIVE-2284. Wildheart's preview wears the stag mark until a logo is uploaded; each theme shows its design page's own nav links (Designer: Portfolio, Services, Book, Events; Network: Come to a meetup, Join, Shop; Temple: Programs, Gatherings, Membership, About; the rest: Offerings, Events, About, Contact); Temple shows its next-gathering card; Bold wears New World outdoor-group pictures as a stand-in until its own library is supplied. Nocturne's design page shows a ticker strip rather than links, so it keeps the default four.
